<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,><C:0001,0004,>- Here Lies a Hero of Buffness -
Muscle Lord Ballance<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>In the war with the Dark Cholesterarians,
Ballance secured victory with signature moves.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>He rolled like a thunderstorm, driving his foes
before him then grinding them to dust.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>His vantage from atop a balance ball allowed him
to keep his equilibrium in both battle and life.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>And his form. His form! His sculpted body would
be a template for those who aspire to buffness.<C:0003,0001,>
